requirements: R1: Reconcile internal task status with GitHub PR state so tasks with closed unmerged PRs are marked failed instead of done.
R2: Clear stuck tasks caused by sync failures to break the Flow Core generation loop in DECOMPOSING state.

slices.title: Patch task sync to handle unmerged PRs and break generation loop
slices.jtbd: When implementing the sync fix for this epic, I want to patch the synchronization logic to correctly update task statuses and clear stuck candidates, so that false completions are avoided and the project flow unblocks.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task marked done with an unmerged closed GitHub PR, When the sync job processes it, Then the task status reverts to failed.
Given the Flow Core is stuck in a generation loop due to sync discrepancies, When the reconciliation runs, Then the stuck candidates are cleared to break the loop.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce sync discrepancy rate and task generation loop occurrences to 0
